tasks.details: Create src/llm/promptCache.ts with LRU cache and TTL support. Store cache as JSON in workspace. APIs: cache(key, payload), retrieve(key), evictByAge(ttlMs), clear(). Support compression for large payloads. Add cache statistics (hits, misses, size).
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for cache insertion, retrieval, eviction. Test TTL expiration. Test LRU eviction when limit reached. Verify workspace file I/O. Test compression on large payloads.

tasks.title: Wire orchestrator panel to executeLLM with response display
tasks.description: Wire the orchestrator panel to the new executeLLM command. Add execute button to task cards, show LLM responses in a side panel, and track execution history.
tasks.details: Update orchestratorPanel.ts to add execute button binding. Create llmResponsePanel.ts to display responses with syntax highlighting. Update taskInteractionAPI.ts to handle LLM execution events. Store execution history in memory entries.
tasks.testStrategy: Integration test: click execute button → see response panel. Verify syntax highlighting for different response types. Test history accumulation.

tasks.title: Implement GitHub Issue Sync bi-directional engine
tasks.description: Build GitHub Issue Sync engine that maintains bidirectional sync between GitHub Issues and internal COE tasks. When issues are created/updated, auto-generate tasks. When tasks complete, update/close issues.
tasks.details: Create src/github/githubClient.ts (Octokit), src/github/webhookHandler.ts, src/services/githubSyncService.ts. Implement: issue → task mapping, task → issue mapping, label sync, milestone sync, assignee sync. Support webhook triggers and manual sync via command.
tasks.testStrategy: Mock GitHub API responses. Test webhook payload parsing. Verify task creation from issues with correct metadata. Test bidirectional status sync. Verify label/milestone/assignee preservation.

tasks.title: Implement copilotDispatcher.test.ts with payload shape validation
tasks.description: Create comprehensive test suite validating PromptPayload structure, message composition, agent profile extraction, and context file handling. Tests should verify that dispatcher output is compatible with OpenAI transport layer.
tasks.details: File: vscode-extension/src/copilotDispatcher.test.ts (~150 LOC). Test cases should cover: (1) Payload structure validation, (2) System/user message composition, (3) Agent profile fields, (4) Context file truncation, (5) Memory preservation, (6) Template substitution, (7) Metadata inclusion. Use Jest/Node test runner. All tests must pass before marking complete. Reference DISPATCHER-SURVEY-ANALYSIS.md section 5.1 for test specifications.
tasks.testStrategy: Run 'npm test' in vscode-extension; verify all new tests pass; verify no regressions in existing tests; check coverage for copilotDispatcher.ts ≥95%."

tasks.title: Implement transportTest.ts for payload-to-LLM mapping validation
tasks.description: Create test suite verifying that PromptPayload messages correctly map to OpenAI-compatible chat/completions format. Tests should verify correlation tracking, context file formatting, and message array validity.
tasks.details: File: vscode-extension/src/llm/transportTest.ts (~100 LOC). Test cases should cover: (1) Message format compatibility with OpenAI API, (2) TaskId correlation preservation, (3) Context file content in messages, (4) Metadata tracking through transport, (5) Header construction for correlation. Use Jest. All tests passing before completion. Reference DISPATCHER-SURVEY-ANALYSIS.md section 5.2 for specifications.
tasks.testStrategy: Run 'npm test'; verify all new tests pass; verify no regressions in llmClient tests; verify correlation headers correctly constructed."

tasks.title: Implement transportTest.ts for LLM payload transport validation
tasks.description: Create comprehensive integration test suite for transport layer. Tests should validate that PromptPayload messages correctly map to OpenAI API format, verify taskId correlation preservation through transport, and confirm metadata tracking.
tasks.details: File: vscode-extension/src/llm/transportTest.ts (~100 LOC). After creating, also add transportTest.ts to npm test script in package.json. Test cases: (1) Message format compatibility with OpenAI /v1/chat/completions API, (2) TaskId correlation in headers and body, (3) Context file handling in messages, (4) Metadata preservation through transport pipeline, (5) Error propagation. Use manual test infrastructure (like other tests) or Jest. Reference DISPATCHER-SURVEY-ANALYSIS.md section 5.2.
tasks.testStrategy: All tests pass; verify no regressions in existing tests; manual test execution with node dist/llm/transportTest.js or included in npm test."
